mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) signals increasing inflation, which typically leads to higher interest rates and reduced equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between the month-over-month change in CPIAUCSL and 20-day S&P 500 returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and 20-day S&P 500 returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in employment (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust economic demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between the joint condition of PAYEMS and HOUST both rising by more than 0.5% m/m and 20-day S&P 500 returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weak labor market that typically triggers central bank policy easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between UNRATE > 5.0% and 20-day S&P 500 returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (the 2017 base), it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO < 100 and 20-day S&P 500 returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When residential sales (RSAFS) fall below 450000 (in millions of dollars), it signals a contraction in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between RSAFS < 450000 and 20-day S&P 500 returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising real GDP (GDPC1) signals a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between the quarter-over-quarter change in GDPC1 and 60-day S&P 500 returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate changes by less than 0.1% month-over-month, it signals monetary stability, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS change < 0.1% m/m and 5-day S&P 500 returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
